prompt: The provided Sized interface has a single method int size(). Complete SizeUtils with two static factories: ofFixed(n) returns a Sized whose size is always n (use a lambda or anonymous class), and largest(items) returns the Sized with the biggest size, or null for an empty array.
explanation: Sized is a functional interface -- one abstract method -- so a lambda like () -> n is a complete implementation, capturing the parameter n. This shows that interfaces describe behavior, not just classes: an object can be conjured on the spot without a named class. largest is a classic max scan that treats every element purely through the interface, so it works for lambdas, anonymous classes, or any future class implementing Sized.
hints: Because Sized has one abstract method, ofFixed can return the lambda () -> n.
In largest, handle the empty array first (return null), then track a 'best' element while looping.
Compare with items[i].size() > best.size() and replace best when the new element is bigger.
